A Chunking document missing starts_after_scene_separator remains incompatible and receives no load-time default, migration, or compatibility branch.

Project opening may continue to reset incompatible Chunking and all downstream derived artifacts through the existing bounded recovery path; this development-phase migration cost is explicitly documented as accepted.
The specification and Text Chunking component documentation state that older schemas are unsupported during development and identify the reset consequences.
The durable requirement set is reconciled rather than duplicated and names a separate planned follow-up contract for a future downstream scene-transition consumer.
No speech-block, audio-block, audio-assembly, settings, or scene-transition runtime behavior changes in this ticket.
Relevant strict-schema and project-open recovery tests, repository pytest and Ruff gates, traceability audit, and coverage audit pass.
assumptions: While AudioMancer remains in development, project artifacts produced by earlier schemas are disposable derived state and are not compatibility targets.
The current canonical schema is the only supported schema; schema corrections may intentionally invalidate older project artifacts.
A downstream consumer for the scene-boundary flag requires a separate product decision and implementation run.
alignment.reason: The owner explicitly selected strict breaking schemas for the development phase. The runtime already rejects the old shape and performs bounded recovery, so this ticket records and verifies existing policy without adding destructive behavior or expanding into an unspecified audio feature.
scope: In scope: reconcile durable requirements, the canonical Cleanup and Chunking specification, and Text Chunking component documentation with the breaking-schema policy; name a future consumer requirement without implementing it; use existing strict-schema and recovery behavior as verification. Out of scope: legacy schema detection or migration, defaulting the missing field, preserving pre-correction derived artifacts, speech/audio scene-transition behavior, new audio settings, and changes to the existing bounded self-heal implementation.
alignment.source: Gitea issue #35 and owner decision in Codex on 2026-07-30
alignment.understanding: During the current development phase, AudioMancer intentionally supports only the latest canonical project-artifact schemas. starts_after_scene_separator remains a required boolean chunk field. A chunks_text.json document missing it is incompatible, and the existing bounded project-open recovery may reset Chunking plus downstream derived artifacts. This ticket records that migration cost as intentional; it adds no compatibility normalization and no downstream audio consumer.
